instruction: Stand the yellow pen upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
zone = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, hz = zone["center"]
rim_h = zone.get("rim_height", 0.08)

# Find grasp candidate across the pen's short axis
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
best_cand = None
for c in candidates:
    if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True):
        best_cand = c
        break
if best_cand is None and candidates:
    best_cand = candidates[0]

# Grasp pen offset towards an end so it can stand upright when rotated/pitched
pen = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]
yaw = pen["long_axis_yaw"]
# Shift grip point along long axis by ~4 cm towards an end
dx = 0.04 * math.cos(yaw)
dy = 0.04 * math.sin(yaw)

grasp_cand = dict(best_cand)
grasp_cand["x"] += dx
grasp_cand["y"] += dy
grasp_res = grasp(grasp_cand)

# Carry above the holder
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.16)

# Reorient gripper to tilt pen vertical (approach horizontal, fingers horizontal)
target_z = hz + rim_h + 0.07
ik_pitch = solve_ik(hx, hy, target_z, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0])
if ik_pitch.get("reachable", False):
    move_gripper(hx, hy, target_z, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0])
else:
    move_gripper(hx, hy, target_z, approach=[0, 1, 0], finger_axis=[-1, 0, 0])

# Lower pen inside the rim and release
move_by(dz=-0.04)
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")
